import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv(
    "./input/labels.csv",
    dtype={
        "key": str,
        "pickup_datetime": str,
        "pickup_longitude": "float32",
        "pickup_latitude": "float32",
        "dropoff_longitude": "float32",
        "dropoff_latitude": "float32",
        "passenger_count": "int16",
        "fare_amount": "float32",
    },
)
test = pd.read_csv(
    "./input/test.csv",
    dtype={
        "key": str,
        "pickup_datetime": str,
        "pickup_longitude": "float32",
        "pickup_latitude": "float32",
        "dropoff_longitude": "float32",
        "dropoff_latitude": "float32",
        "passenger_count": "int16",
    },
)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print("Cleaning training data...")
train = train[(train["fare_amount"] > 0) & (train["fare_amount"] <= 100)].copy()
train = train[train["passenger_count"].isin([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6])].copy()
coord_mask = (
    (train["pickup_latitude"] >= 40.5)
    & (train["pickup_latitude"] <= 41.3)
    & (train["pickup_longitude"] >= -74.3)
    & (train["pickup_longitude"] <= -73.5)
    & (train["dropoff_latitude"] >= 40.5)
    & (train["dropoff_latitude"] <= 41.3)
    & (train["dropoff_longitude"] >= -74.3)
    & (train["dropoff_longitude"] <= -73.5)
)
train = train[coord_mask].copy()
print(f"Cleaned training rows: {len(train)}")


def preprocess(df):
    if "pickup_datetime" in df.columns:
        dates = pd.to_datetime(
            df["pickup_datetime"].astype(str).str.replace(" UTC", "", regex=False)
        )
        df["hour"] = dates.dt.hour.values
        df["dayofweek"] = dates.dt.dayofweek.values
        df["month"] = dates.dt.month.values

    R = 3959.0
    lat1 = np.deg2rad(df["pickup_latitude"].values)
    lat2 = np.deg2rad(df["dropoff_latitude"].values)
    dlat = np.deg2rad(df["dropoff_latitude"].values - df["pickup_latitude"].values)
    dlon = np.deg2rad(df["dropoff_longitude"].values - df["pickup_longitude"].values)

    a = np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    df["distance"] = 2 * R * np.arctan2(np.sqrt(a), np.sqrt(1 - a))
    df["distance"] = df["distance"].fillna(0).clip(0, 50)

    df["dlat"] = df["dropoff_latitude"].values - df["pickup_latitude"].values
    df["dlon"] = df["dropoff_longitude"].values - df["pickup_longitude"].values
    return df


train = preprocess(train)
test = preprocess(test)

y = train["fare_amount"].values
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_longitude",
    "pickup_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "hour",
    "dayofweek",
    "month",
    "distance",
    "dlat",
    "dlon",
]
X = train[feature_cols].values
X_test = test[feature_cols].values

X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, shuffle=True
)

print("Training LightGBM on training split...")
model = lgb.LGBMRegressor(
    n_estimators=1000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=6,
    num_leaves=31,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=False,
)
model.fit(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50)],
)

val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, val_preds))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {rmse}")

print("Retraining on full training data for submission...")
full_model = lgb.LGBMRegressor(**model.get_params())
full_model.fit(X, y, callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50)])

test_preds = full_model.predict(X_test)

submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission["fare_amount"] = test_preds
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
